cards.audioText: When and where did you complete your most recent transition training?
cards.taskTitle: 其它-当前位置与工作背景-3
cards.audioTextZh: 你最近一次转机型训练是在何时、何地完成的？
cards.referenceText: I have not completed any transition training yet.
cards.referenceTextZh: 我还没有完成任何转机型训练。

cards.audioText: Have you completed any high-performance aircraft training? If so, what did it cover?
cards.taskTitle: 其它-当前位置与工作背景-5
cards.audioTextZh: 你是否完成过高性能航空器训练？如果有，培训内容是什么？
cards.referenceText: No, I have not completed high-performance aircraft training yet. I am still training on the DA-40 at flight school, so I do not claim any syllabus, qualification, or flight time for a high-performance aircraft. I would complete the programme approved for the relevant aircraft before operating one.
cards.referenceTextZh: 没有，我还没有完成高性能飞机训练。目前仍在航校使用 DA-40 训练，因此不会声称自己具备高性能飞机的课程经历、资质或飞行时间。驾驶相关飞机前，我会完成经批准的训练方案。

cards.audioText: Which aircraft type did your most recent transition training cover?
cards.taskTitle: 其它-当前位置与工作背景-4
cards.audioTextZh: 你最近一次转机型训练针对哪种机型？
cards.referenceText: No aircraft type applies because I have not completed any transition training yet.
cards.referenceTextZh: 没有适用机型，因为我还没有完成任何转机型训练。

cards.audioText: How many flight hours did you accumulate during high-performance flight training?
cards.taskTitle: 其它-当前位置与工作背景-7
cards.audioTextZh: 你在高性能飞行训练期间积累了多少飞行小时？
cards.referenceText: I have not accumulated any hours in high-performance flight training because I have not started that training yet. My current flight time has been gained during ordinary flight training on the DA-40.
cards.referenceTextZh: 我还没有开始高性能飞行训练，因此没有积累相关飞行时间。目前的飞行时间来自使用 DA-40 进行的普通飞行训练。

cards.audioText: When and where did you complete your high-performance flight training?
cards.taskTitle: 其它-当前位置与工作背景-6
cards.audioTextZh: 你在何时、何地完成了高性能飞行训练？
cards.referenceText: I have not completed high-performance flight training yet. I am still receiving flight training at a flight school.
cards.referenceTextZh: 我还没有完成高性能飞行训练，目前仍在航校接受飞行训练。

cards.audioText: When is your next simulator training?
cards.audioTextZh: 你什么时候参加下次模拟训练？
cards.referenceText: I just finished my simulator training last month, and we have simulator training twice every year, so the next one will be in five months.
cards.referenceTextZh: 上个月我刚结束模拟训练，我们每年训练两次，下次训练会在五个月内。

cards.audioText: When did you get the Private Pilot License?
cards.audioTextZh: 你什么时候拿到私照的？
cards.referenceText: I got the Private Pilot License in June 4th 2019.
cards.referenceTextZh: 我在2019年6月4日拿到了私照。

cards.audioText: What are the unforgettable things during your initial training?
cards.audioTextZh: 在初始训练期间，有哪些难忘的时刻？
cards.referenceText:
Well, my first solo flight was one of the most unforgettable moments of my initial training.
That was a sunny day. The visibility was good, wind was calm. It was good for flying.
I flew two traffic patterns and made a successful landing.
cards.referenceTextZh:
在初始训练中，我的单飞是最难忘的时刻之一。
那是阳光明媚的一天。能见度很好，静风，很适合飞行。
我飞了两个起落，最后成功着陆。

cards.audioText: Were you nervous at your first solo, how did you overcome it?
cards.audioTextZh: 单飞的时候紧张吗，你是如何克服它的？
cards.referenceText:
Yes, I was a little nervous.
My flight instructor encouraged me and helped me to calm down.
After I walked into the cockpit, I just focused on my operation, and I forgot my nervousness.
cards.referenceTextZh:
是的，我有点紧张。
我的飞行教员给了我鼓励，并帮助我平静下来。
当走进驾驶舱后，我专注于操作，忘记了紧张。

cards.audioText: When and where did you have the initial training?
cards.audioTextZh: 你什么时候在哪里进行的初始训练？
cards.referenceText:
I had / received my initial training in CAFUC (Civil Aviation Flight University of China) in 2008.
In the first two years in university, I studied basic flight theories and aviation English in Guanghan, Sichuan Province.
In the third year, I had my primary flight training in Luoyang Branch, Henan Province.
cards.referenceTextZh:
我于2008年在中国民航飞行学院学飞飞行。
大学前两年，我在四川广汉飞行学院学习飞行基本理论和航空英语。
第三年，我在河南洛阳进行初级飞行训练。

cards.audioText: What subjects should you practise in simulator?
cards.audioTextZh: 模拟机训练的科目都有哪些？
cards.referenceText:
In simulator, we mainly practise normal procedures and abnormal procedures.
Such as engine problem, adverse weather conditions and so on.
cards.referenceTextZh:
在模拟机训练中，我们需要练习正常程序和非正常程序。
比如发动机故障、不利天气条件等。

cards.audioText: How many hours should you experience simulator training during your initial training?
cards.audioTextZh: 在初始训练中，你们需要经历多长时间的模拟机训练？
cards.referenceText: About 40 hours. And we should finish it in 5 weeks.
cards.referenceTextZh: 40小时左右，我们需要在5周内完成。

cards.audioText: What subject was the most difficult for you during the initial training?
cards.audioTextZh: 初始训练中，什么科目对你来说最困难？
cards.referenceText:
I think stall is the most difficult one for me.
Because it was difficult to control the aircraft and recover from the stall.
The aircraft may crash on the ground.
cards.referenceTextZh:
我认为失速对我来说最困难。
因为操纵飞机和失速改出很困难。
飞机可能会坠机。

cards.audioText: Why do pilots need recurrent training each year?
cards.audioTextZh: 飞行员为什么需要复训？
cards.referenceText:
Recurrent training is very necessary.
It can help us to review abnormal procedures.
It can help us be familiar with all kinds of normal/abnormal situations.
It is very important for improving flight safety.
cards.referenceTextZh:
复训非常有必要。
它帮我们回顾不正常程序。
它帮助我们熟悉各种正常/非正常情况。
它对提高飞行安全很重要。

cards.audioText: What have you learned from your flight instructor?
cards.audioTextZh: 你从飞行教员那里学到了什么？
cards.referenceText:
I have learned a lot from my flight instructor.
First, I have learned many flight skills.
Second, I have learned how to be a responsible man.
cards.referenceTextZh:
我从飞行教员那里学到了很多东西。
首先，我学到了很多飞行技术。
其次，我学到了如何做一个负责的人。

cards.audioText: What are the subjects you will practice with flight attendants during the training?
cards.audioTextZh: 和机组训练时，你们会训练哪些科目？
cards.referenceText: Usually, we will practice some abnormal procedures, for example, rejected takeoff, cabin depressurization, and emergency evacuation.
cards.referenceTextZh: 通常，我们会训练一些非正常情况，譬如：中断起飞，客舱失压或者紧急撤离。

cards.audioText: When and where did you have the recurrent training?
cards.audioTextZh: 你什么时候在哪里进行了复训？
cards.referenceText: I had my current training in 2008 in China Eastern Airline.
cards.referenceTextZh: 我于2008年在东航进行的复训。

cards.audioText: Why do you need simulator training?
cards.audioTextZh: 为什么我们需要模拟机训练？
cards.referenceText:
Well, as we all know, simulator training is necessary for flight safety.
We can review many emergency situations which cannot be practised in real flight.
So that before a real flight, we can gain flying experience.
cards.referenceTextZh:
我们知道，对飞行安全来说，模拟机训练是必要的。
我们可以回顾许多在真实飞行中无法练习的紧急情况。
因此在实践飞行之前，我们可以获取更多飞行经验。

cards.audioText: During your simulator training, do you have any session related to a hydraulic system failure? How did you handle it in simulator?
cards.audioTextZh: 在模拟机训练中，你们有关于液压失效的练习项目吗？你是如何在模拟机训练中处理的？
cards.referenceText:
Yes, I have.
Hydraulic system failure may cause landing gear jammed, brakes malfunction and so on.
For example, if I encounter landing gear jammed, I should try manual extension, make a low pass for visual check.
If necessary, I will make a belly landing.
cards.referenceTextZh:
是的，我们有相关科目。
液压系统失效会造成起落架卡阻，刹车故障等问题。
比如，如果我遇到起落架卡阻，我会尝试手动收放，做低空通场进行目视检查。
如有必要，我会执行机腹着陆。

cards.audioText: Where do you have your simulator training? What do you learn from it?
cards.audioTextZh: 你在哪里参加的模拟机训练？从中学到了什么？
cards.referenceText: I have my simulator training in Guanghan Simulator Training Center. During the training, I review/practice emergency procedures, which makes me more confident and courageous when facing abnormal situations.
cards.referenceTextZh: 我在广州模拟训练中心进行模拟机训练。训练期间，我复习/练习了应急程序，这让我在面对异常状况的时候更加自信、勇敢。

cards.audioText: What do you think is the purpose of the simulator training?
cards.audioTextZh: 你认为参加模拟训练的目的是什么？
cards.referenceText: Well, I don't think the purpose of the simulator training is to completely take place of actual flight training but to thoroughly familiarize pilots with the aircraft concerned before they maneuver costly and riskily actual flight training. Simulator training also is useful for reviewing and familiarizing pilots with new modifications to existing aircraft.
cards.referenceTextZh: 嗯，我认为参加模拟训练的目的并不完全是为了替代实际飞行训练，而是在飞行员们进行昂贵且危险的实际飞行训练演习之前，使之完全熟悉相关飞机。模拟训练有助于飞行员研究和熟悉现有飞机的改变。

cards.audioText: How often does your company provide simulator training?
cards.audioTextZh: 你公司多久进行一次模拟机复训？
cards.referenceText: Every six months.
cards.referenceTextZh: 每六个月一次。

cards.audioText: What do you think is the most difficult part in your flight training? How do you cope with/overcome it?
cards.audioTextZh: 在飞行训练中，你认为哪部分是最困难的？你是怎样解决/克服它的？
cards.referenceText:
In my flight training, especially during the primary training, I think the most difficult part is landing. In this stage, we have to consider many factors, descend rate, thrust, weather condition, approach speed and so on. All these factors will affect landing safety. Although it was a little bit difficult for me at first, I believe
practice makes perfect, so I study hard and after hundred times of practice, I can make better landings now.

In my flight training, I think the most difficult part is to deal with abnormal situations. In order to cope with such situations, we should have much knowledge on aviation, practice more and try to familiarize ourselves with all kinds of abnormal procedures.
cards.referenceTextZh:
在飞行训练中，特别是初级训练时，我认为最困难的部分是降落。在这个阶段，我们必须考虑诸多因素，下降率、推力、天气状况、进近速度等。所有这些因素都会影响降落安全。虽然起初这对我来说有点困难，但我相信熟能生巧。所以我努力练习，经过数百次实践，现在我可以更好地降落。

飞行训练中，我觉得最困难的部分是处理异常状况。为了应对这些状况，我们应该学习更多的航天知识，勤加练习，让自己熟悉更多的非正常程序。

cards.audioText: Can you list some subjects in your simulator training?
cards.audioTextZh: 能否列举一些模拟训练中的项目？
cards.referenceText: Yes, in the simulator training, we practice some procedures including engine fire, both engine failure, cabin depressurization, and so on.
cards.referenceTextZh: 好的，在模拟训练中，我们练习一些应急程序，包括发动机熄火、两发失效、机舱减压等。

cards.audioText: How many hours do you usually need for simulator training each year?
cards.audioTextZh: 你每年要进行多长时间的模拟器训练？
cards.referenceText: I have 16 hours' simulator training every time. It's divided into 4 days, 4 hours a day, and I have simulator training twice every year, so all together I have 32 hours' simulator training every year.
cards.referenceTextZh: 我每次要进行16小时的模拟器训练。这16个小时分成四天完成，每天4小时。我每年要参加两次训练，所以每年共进行32小时训练。

cards.audioText: Where did you have the initial training as a student pilot? Can you say something about that?
cards.audioTextZh: 你在哪里接受初级培训的？能否讲一下？
cards.referenceText:
Yes. I had my initial training in CAFUC in 2008 and the aircraft type I flew was C172. I spent 2 years there with 40 classmates. At first stage, we studied ground theory and aircraft system in computer-based training (CBT). After we passed the test, a flight instructor guided us to practice flight control in the simulator. Initial
training gave me a general idea about the aircraft. It is a very useful and helpful experience for me.
cards.referenceTextZh: 好的。2008年我在中国民航飞行学院接受初级培训，飞的是C172。我和40名同学在这里学习了两年。第一阶段，我们学习了地面理论，并通过计算机辅助训练（CBT）熟悉了飞机构造。通过考试后，飞行教练指导我们在模拟机中练习飞行控制。初级训练后我对飞机有了大致了解。这对我来说是一段非常有用和有益的经验。

cards.audioText: How often do you take proficiency check?
cards.audioTextZh: 你多久参加一次熟练检查？
cards.referenceText: According to CCAR 121, I take the proficiency testing every 6 months.
cards.referenceTextZh: 根据局方规定，每6个月参加一次熟练检查。

cards.audioText: Do you practice cabin depressurization in the simulator? How would you perform?
cards.audioTextZh: 你在模拟机中练习过处理座舱降压么？你会如何处理这种情况？
cards.referenceText: Yes, I do. In the simulator, similar abnormal situations are usually set up and the flight crew need to complete the emergency procedures. We should wear the oxygen masks, at the same time, we need to make sure the passengers' masks are deployed. Also, we should notify the ATC to request to deviate and descend immediately to a lower altitude to ensure the passengers to breathe without an oxygen mask and avoid any possible airframe damage.
cards.referenceTextZh: 是的，我练习过。在模拟机中经常会设置非正常情况，机组人员需要完成紧急程序。我们应该戴上氧气面罩，同时要确保乘客的面罩也已戴好。此外我们应该通知ATC要求改航，并立即下降到较低的高度，以确保乘客能够正常呼吸，并避免机身受到任何损坏。

cards.audioText: What do you think of your recurrent training?
cards.audioTextZh: 你觉得你的复训怎么样？
cards.referenceText: In the recurrent training, there are lots of practice and training about many emergency procedures. I learned much about how to handle emergency situations, such as engine fire, hydraulic failure, communication failure, stall, aborted takeoff, emergency evacuation and so on. In our flight, although we normally can not encounter these conditions, there is a saying that "forewarned is forearmed". We are required to continuously improve our flight skills and learn to handle/cope with the emergency conditions in the training.
cards.referenceTextZh: 复训期间，我们要做大量的关于紧急程序的培训及实践。我学到了很多关于如何处理紧急状况的知识，包括处理发动机失火、液压故障、通讯故障、失速、起飞中断、紧急疏散等。尽管飞行中一般不会遇到这些情况，但俗话说“有备无患”。在训练中我们被要求不断提高飞行技能，学习解决紧急状况。

cards.audioText: What do you think are the benefits of simulator training?
cards.audioTextZh: 你认为模拟机训练的好处是什么？
cards.referenceText: I think simulator training has become very important in preparing for being a qualified pilot. Firstly, it helps pilots become familiar with abnormal situations. Practicing in a simulated environment can help a pilot remain level headed during crisis so that he/she can work effectively when dealing with emergency. Secondly, simulator training can help a pilot see the gaps in real flight. There could be some shortcomings in capability when flying, so during simulation training, a pilot gets the opportunity to practice more without risking the safety of aircraft and the people inside.
cards.referenceTextZh: 我认为参加模拟机训练在成为合格飞行员的准备过程中是非常重要的。第一，它帮助飞行员熟悉异常情况。在一个模拟的环境中练习可以帮助飞行员在遇到危机时仍能保持头脑清醒，在处理紧急情况时更加高效地工作。第二，模拟训练可以让飞行员找到真实飞行中的一些不足之处。飞行员在真实飞行中可能有些能力不足之处，所以在模拟训练时，飞行员可以有更多的练习机会，而不会危及到飞机及机内人员的安全。

cards.audioText: Please say something about your simulator training you have received.
cards.audioTextZh: 请讲讲你所接受的模拟训练。
cards.referenceText: OK. In Air China, we had lots of chances to practice different kinds of simulator training both at home and aboard. The simulator training, I had received included initial training, transition training and recurrent training. For me, most knowledge of handling abnormal and emergency situations was got from simulator training.
cards.referenceTextZh: 好的。在国航，我们有大量在国内外的进行各种模拟训练的机会。我所接受的模拟训练包括初级训练、改装训练和复训。对我来说，大部分处理异常和紧急情况的知识都是从模拟训练中获得的。

cards.audioText: Can you choose your favorite type of aircraft for flight training?
cards.audioTextZh: 你能否选择自己喜欢的机型参加飞行训练？
cards.referenceText: No, I cannot. We pilots can't make our own choices of types of aircraft. In fact, we get models distributed according to the hours we have flown and stages we have been training.
cards.referenceTextZh: 不，无法选择。飞行员不能自行决定要飞的机型。实际上，我们是根据飞行时间和训练阶段来分配机型的。

cards.audioText: Please tell me the advantages and disadvantages of the simulator training.
cards.audioTextZh: 说一下模拟机训练的优缺点。
cards.referenceText: Relative to real aircraft training, the simulator training has many advantages. Firstly, its cost is much lower. Pilots can practice as many times as they like. Secondly, there is no danger in practicing abnormal situations. Thirdly, the company bears no risk of fatal accidents, and there are also some disadvantages for simulator training. For example, because of the limitation of the existing technology, the feedback and movement of the simulator may not be as real as the real aircraft.
cards.referenceTextZh: 好的。相较于真实训练，模拟机训练有许多优点。第一，成本相对较低。飞行员想练多少次都可以；第二，模拟机训练可以毫无风险地练习异常情况；第三，公司不用承担事故风险。同时模拟机训练也有一些缺点。例如，由于现有科技的限制，模拟机的反馈和动作都不是太真实。

cards.audioText: What's the most important thing you have learned from your training?
cards.audioTextZh: 你在训练中学到的最重要的东西是什么？
cards.referenceText: Leaving the practical and professional knowledge aside, I have acquired some important practical experience through many abnormal and emergency situation practices, I think it's the most important thing I have learned that can make me qualified to handle lots of problems in my flight career in future.
cards.referenceTextZh: 除了实用和专业的知识外，通过大量练习处理异常及紧急情况，我还获得了一些重要的实践经验。我认为我学到的最重要的东西就是通过这些练习我能够处理许多未来飞行生涯中可能遇到的问题。

cards.audioText: What significant influence did the simulated training exert on your flight career?
cards.audioTextZh: 模拟训练对你的飞行事业有哪些显著的影响？
cards.referenceText: We practiced many simulated training about abnormal and emergency situations which might happen in real flight. Because of such training, we have been familiar with the procedure of various abnormal and emergency situations, which is very useful to ensure the flight safety.
cards.referenceTextZh: 我们做过多次关于异常及紧急情况的模拟训练，这些情况都可能发生在真实飞行中。因为这些训练，我们已经熟悉了应对各种异常及紧急情况的操作程序，这对保证飞行安全来说是非常有用的。

cards.audioText: How often do you take recurrent training?
cards.audioTextZh: 你多久参加一次复训？
cards.referenceText: According to CCAR 121, I take the recurrent training every 12 months.
cards.referenceTextZh: 根据局方121部规定，每12个月参加一次复训。

cards.audioText: Did you experience any emergency procedures during simulator training?
cards.audioTextZh: 在模拟训练时，你练习过紧急程序么？
cards.referenceText: Yes. The emergency procedures are the most important parts of the simulator training. In the simulator training, we practiced almost every possibility of the emergency situations, especially some usual emergency, such as engine failure, engine fire, emergency descent, wind shear, emergency evacuation and so on.
cards.referenceTextZh: 遇到过。紧急程序是模拟训练中最重要的部分。在训练中，我们几乎练习了所有可能发生的紧急情况，尤其是一些常发生的紧急情况，如发动机熄火、发动机起火、紧急下降、风切变、紧急疏散等。

cards.audioText: Do you have any training experience of evacuation? Tell me about it.
cards.audioTextZh: 你是否接受过疏散训练么？给我讲一下。
cards.referenceText: Yes, I have had evacuation training for many times. For example, when I had my initial training of evacuation in London, the flight instructor simulated the cockpit fire. As the pilot flew, my co-pilot and I had our oxygen masks worn. Then I requested the purser to execute the evacuation following the standard operation procedures. Whereafter I made an announcement through the passenger addressing system to tell the passengers the reasons and precautions in executing the emergency evacuation. In the process, everything was completed orderly and efficiently.
cards.referenceTextZh: 是的，我接受过很多次疏散训练。例如，我在伦敦接受第一次疏散训练时，教员模拟了驾驶舱失火。作为训练的飞行员，我和副驾驶都带上了氧气面罩。之后我要求乘务长按照标准操作程序撤离，并通过定址系统告知乘客紧急疏散的原因和预防程序。整个过程中，一切都高效、有序地完成。

cards.audioText: What was the most impressing in your flight training?
cards.audioTextZh: 你在飞行训练中遇到的最难忘的事情是什么？
cards.referenceText: What impressed me most was that instructors went out of their way to teach us operating skills and made us deeply know what a pilot meant to a flight. At that time, I determined to try my best to take my responsibility to ensure the safety of the passengers on the flight.
cards.referenceTextZh: 我印象最深刻的是，教员不辞辛苦教我们操作技巧，让我们深切地了解到飞行员对于飞机的意义。那时，我决定要尽我所能完成任务，保证机上乘客的安全。

cards.audioText: What subjects are compulsory in your flight school?
cards.audioTextZh: 你们航校有哪些必修科目？
cards.referenceText: There are many compulsory subjects in my flight school. And we need to learn not only the relevant theoretical knowledge about aviation, but also some operating procedures on how to control the aircraft, for example, touch and go, traffic pattern, steep turn, stall recovery and so on.
cards.referenceTextZh: 我们航校有很多必修课程。我们不仅需要学习相关的民航理论知识，还要学习一些操纵飞机的程序，譬如：连续起落，起落航线，大坡度转弯，失速改出等。

cards.audioText: Could you describe your life at your flight school?
cards.audioTextZh: 你能描述一下自己在航校里的生活吗？
cards.referenceText: My life in the flight school are colorful. Usually, we have ground training and flight training, for example, we have learned the course about radio-telephony in English, the flight theory, the navigation and some other subjects in the ground training. When we have free time, we will play basketball with our flight instructors or read books with friends to learn flight knowledge.
cards.referenceTextZh: 我在航校的生活丰富多彩。通常，我们会有地面理论课程和飞行训练课程，例如在地面理论课程中，我们会学习英语无线电陆空通话、飞行原理、领航还有其他科目。当我们有时间时，我们会和教员们一起打篮球或者和同学们一起看书来学习飞行知识。

cards.audioText: Where did you learn flying, at home or abroad?
cards.audioTextZh: 你在哪里学习的飞行，在国内还是国外？
cards.referenceText: I learned to fly in BUAA (Beihang University), so it is in China.
cards.referenceTextZh: 我在北航学的飞行，所以是在国内。

cards.audioText: Can you tell me something about your flight school?
cards.audioTextZh: 你能告诉我你的航校吗？
cards.referenceText: My flight school is Qingdao Jiutian International Flight Academy. It is located in Qingdao, Shandong province. There are many types of aircraft for us to have the flight training, for example, the Cessna 172 and PA44.
cards.referenceTextZh: 我的航校是青岛九天国际航校，它位于山东青岛市。学校很多类型的飞机供我们进行飞行训练，比如：塞斯纳172和PA44。

cards.audioText: Why is emergency training important for pilots?
cards.audioTextZh: 为什么应急训练对飞行员很重要？
cards.referenceText: It lets pilots practice recognizing threats, applying the correct procedures, and sharing tasks under pressure. Realistic training can improve decision-making and coordination. It also helps identify weaknesses before an actual emergency occurs.
cards.referenceTextZh: 应急训练让飞行员练习识别威胁、使用正确程序及压力下分工。贴近实际的训练可改善决策和协作，也有助于在真实紧急情况发生前发现薄弱环节。

cards.audioText: Can you describe your first solo flight?
cards.audioTextZh: 你能描述一下第一次单飞吗？
cards.referenceText: My first solo took place on a sunny day with good visibility and calm wind. I flew two traffic patterns and completed a successful landing. It became one of the most unforgettable moments of my training.
cards.referenceTextZh: 我的第一次单飞是在一个晴朗、能见度良好且风平稳的日子。我飞了两个起落航线并成功着陆。这成为我训练中最难忘的时刻之一。

cards.audioText: Have you practiced handling a hydraulic system failure in a simulator? If so, how did you handle it?
cards.audioTextZh: 你在模拟机中练习过处置液压系统失效吗？如果练习过，你是如何处置的？
cards.referenceText: Yes. In the simulator, I first stayed calm, checked the indications, and followed the applicable emergency procedure. I used the remaining or backup hydraulic system if available, maintained aircraft control, and coordinated with the instructor or other crew members. I then planned a diversion to a suitable alternate airport.
cards.referenceTextZh: 是的。在模拟机中，我首先保持冷静、核对指示并遵循适用的应急程序。如果有可用的剩余或备用液压系统，我会使用它，同时控制好飞机，并与教员或其他机组成员协调。随后，我会计划改航至合适的备降机场。

cards.audioText: What subjects do you review during recurrent training?
cards.audioTextZh: 复训期间你会复习哪些科目？
cards.referenceText: We review normal procedures such as traffic patterns, holding patterns, and precision approaches. We also practice abnormal situations such as a rejected takeoff, engine failure, and hydraulic-system failure.
cards.referenceTextZh: 我们会复习起落航线、等待航线和精密进近等正常程序，也会练习中断起飞、发动机失效和液压系统失效等非正常情况。

cards.audioText: How many training hours do you complete during each recurrent training session?
cards.audioTextZh: 每次复训你要完成多少小时的训练？
cards.referenceText: Each simulator training session at my flight school lasts about three hours, depending on the training subject.
cards.referenceTextZh: 航校每次模拟机训练大约持续三小时，具体取决于训练科目。

cards.audioText: Why is recurrent training important for pilots?
cards.audioTextZh: 为什么复训对飞行员很重要？
cards.referenceText: Recurrent training helps pilots review procedures and emergency actions, maintain their skills, and refresh knowledge that may have been forgotten. It also helps them adapt to changes in technology, procedures, and regulations and identify areas that need improvement. The training can improve communication and cooperation between crew members.
cards.referenceTextZh: 复训帮助飞行员复习程序和应急动作、保持技能，并更新可能已经遗忘的知识。它还帮助他们适应技术、程序和法规变化，并发现需要改进的方面。培训也能改善机组成员之间的沟通与合作。

cards.audioText: What subjects were included in your initial flight training?
cards.audioTextZh: 你初始训练包含哪些训练科目？
cards.referenceText:
We have learned many subjects during the initial flight training.
Such as local training, cross-country training, high speed approach, stall, steep turn and so on.
cards.referenceTextZh:
初始训练我们学会了很多科目。
比如：本场训练，转场训练，大速度进近，失速，大坡度转弯等。

cards.audioText: When did you obtain your pilot licenses and ratings?
cards.audioTextZh: 你何时取得飞行员执照和等级？
cards.referenceText: I have not obtained a pilot licence or additional ratings yet because I am still a student pilot. I am completing my flight training and will take the required tests when I meet the applicable experience and training requirements.
cards.referenceTextZh: 我还没有取得飞行员执照或其他等级，因为我仍是一名学员飞行员。我正在完成飞行训练，达到适用的经历和训练要求后会参加规定考试。

cards.audioText: Which recurrent training subject do you find most difficult, and why?
cards.audioTextZh: 你觉得哪个复训科目最难？为什么？
cards.referenceText: I find engine-failure training the most difficult because the DA-40 I fly has a single engine, so an engine failure means a complete loss of power. The situation requires quick decisions and actions, and choosing the right time and place for a forced landing is especially difficult for a less experienced pilot.
cards.referenceTextZh: 我认为发动机失效训练最困难，因为我飞的 DA-40 是单发飞机，发动机失效就意味着动力完全丧失。这种情况要求快速决策和行动，而对于经验较少的飞行员来说，选择迫降的正确时机和地点尤其困难。

cards.audioText: How many hours of simulator training have you completed?
cards.audioTextZh: 你已经完成了多少小时的模拟机训练？
cards.referenceText: I have completed about 40 hours of simulator training.
cards.referenceTextZh: 我已经完成大约 40 小时的模拟机训练。

cards.audioText: When was your first solo flight?
cards.audioTextZh: 你什么时候放的单飞？
cards.referenceText: My first solo fight was on May 1st, 2019 (about 2 years ago).
cards.referenceTextZh: 我的第一次单飞是在2019年5月1日（大约两年前）。

cards.audioText: How often do you receive recurrent training?
cards.audioTextZh: 你多久接受一次复训？
cards.referenceText: At flight school, I receive simulator training once a month.
cards.referenceTextZh: 在航校，我每月接受一次模拟机训练。

cards.audioText: What have you learned from your flight instructors?
cards.audioTextZh: 你从飞行教员那里学到了什么？
cards.referenceText: My flight instructors taught me flight skills, professional knowledge, and emergency procedures. They also taught me to put safety first, follow procedures, stay calm, and make responsible decisions. I learned the value of teamwork and effective communication as well.
cards.referenceTextZh: 飞行教员教给我飞行技能、专业知识和应急程序。他们还教我把安全放在首位、遵循程序、保持冷静并作出负责任的决策。我也学到了团队合作和有效沟通的价值。

cards.audioText: What did you learn from your first solo flight?
cards.audioTextZh: 从单飞中你学到了什么？
cards.referenceText:
I have learned many things from my first solo flight.
First, we should make good preflight preparation to make flight easier and safer.
Second, we should follow the checklist and follow SOP to ensure flight safety.
cards.referenceTextZh:
我从单飞中学到了很多。
首先，我们应该做好飞行前准备，使飞行简单安全。
其次，我们应该遵照检查单和标准操作程序确保飞行安全。

cards.audioText: Do you enjoy simulator training? Why or why not?
cards.audioTextZh: 你喜欢模拟机训练吗？为什么？
cards.referenceText: Yes, I enjoy simulator training because it helps me improve my flying skills.
cards.referenceTextZh: 是的，我喜欢模拟机训练，因为它能帮助我提高飞行技能。

cards.audioText: What was the most unforgettable moment of your flight training?
cards.audioTextZh: 飞行训练中最令你难忘的时刻是什么？
cards.referenceText: My most unforgettable moment was my first solo flight. I was nervous at first, but I gradually calmed down and completed the flight successfully. After landing, I felt excited, proud, and more confident in my flying skills.
cards.referenceTextZh: 我最难忘的时刻是第一次单飞。起初我很紧张，但逐渐冷静下来，并顺利完成飞行。着陆后，我感到兴奋、自豪，也对自己的飞行技能更有信心。

cards.audioText: Could you describe the flight school where you received your initial training?
cards.audioTextZh: 你能否介绍一下自己接受初始训练的飞行学校？
cards.referenceText: My flight school is in a city with convenient transport. It has experienced flight instructors and ground teachers, modern training aircraft and simulators, and courses in theory, flying skills, and emergency handling. The school places strong emphasis on training safety and quality.
cards.referenceTextZh: 我的航校位于一座交通便利的城市。学校拥有经验丰富的飞行教员和地面教员、现代化训练飞机和模拟机，并开设理论、飞行技能和应急处置课程。学校非常重视训练安全和质量。

cards.audioText: Which subject did you find most difficult during your initial flight training?
cards.audioTextZh: 初始飞行训练中，你觉得哪个科目最难？
cards.referenceText: I found stall training the most difficult because controlling the aircraft and recovering from a stall were challenging for me.
cards.referenceTextZh: 我认为失速训练最困难，因为控制飞机并从失速中改出对我来说很有挑战。

cards.audioText: What subjects can pilots practice during simulator training?
cards.audioTextZh: 飞行员可以在模拟机训练中练习哪些科目？
cards.referenceText: Pilots can practice engine failures, engine fires, hydraulic and electrical failures, and flapless landings in a simulator.
cards.referenceTextZh: 飞行员可以在模拟机中练习发动机失效、发动机火灾、液压和电气故障，以及无襟翼着陆。

cards.audioText: Have you reviewed emergency procedures during simulator training? If so, which ones?
cards.audioTextZh: 你在模拟机训练中复习过应急程序吗？如果复习过，具体有哪些？
cards.referenceText: Yes. I reviewed procedures for engine failure, depressurization, fire, bird strike, runway incursion, and evacuation. The training emphasized SOP compliance, decision-making, and crew coordination.
cards.referenceTextZh: 是的。我复习了发动机失效、失压、火灾、鸟击、跑道侵入和撤离程序。培训强调遵守标准操作程序、决策和机组协调。

cards.audioText: How would you describe your flight instructor?
cards.audioTextZh: 你会如何描述自己的飞行教员？
cards.referenceText: My flight instructor is kind, supportive, professional, and strict about standards. He teaches aeronautical knowledge and flying techniques and always emphasizes safety, calm decision-making, teamwork, and good communication.
cards.referenceTextZh: 我的飞行教员友善、乐于支持、专业，并且严格执行标准。他教授航空知识和飞行技术，始终强调安全、冷静决策、团队合作和良好沟通。

cards.audioText: Why is simulator training important for pilots?
cards.audioTextZh: 为什么模拟机训练对飞行员很重要？
cards.referenceText: Simulator training lets pilots practice complex, abnormal, and emergency situations without the risks of an actual flight. They can repeat a scenario until their handling skills improve. It also helps them learn aircraft systems and procedures and strengthen situational awareness and emergency response.
cards.referenceTextZh: 模拟机训练让飞行员能够在没有实际飞行风险的情况下练习复杂、非正常和紧急情景。他们可以反复练习同一情景，直到操纵技能得到提高。训练还帮助他们学习飞机系统和程序，并增强情景意识和应急响应能力。

cards.audioText: Does your airline provide training for operations at unfamiliar airports?
cards.audioTextZh: 你所在的航空公司是否提供陌生机场运行培训？
cards.referenceText: I am not currently employed by an airline, so I have not received airline training for unfamiliar airports. At flight school, we prepare by reviewing charts, terrain, weather, runway information, and any special procedures. Simulator practice or an instructor briefing can be added when the airport presents unusual risks.
cards.referenceTextZh: 我目前尚未受雇于航空公司，因此没有接受过针对不熟悉机场的航空公司培训。在航校，我们通过查看航图、地形、天气、跑道信息和任何特殊程序来准备。机场存在特殊风险时，还可以增加模拟机练习或教员简令。

cards.audioText: Where did you receive your initial flight training?
cards.audioTextZh: 你在哪里接受初始飞行训练？
cards.referenceText: I received my initial flight training at Zhanghe Airport.
cards.referenceTextZh: 我在漳河机场接受了初始飞行训练。

cards.audioText: Where do you receive your recurrent training?
cards.audioTextZh: 你在哪里接受复训？
cards.referenceText: I have not received company recurrent training yet because I am still training at flight school. My current program includes simulator training there.
cards.referenceTextZh: 我尚未接受公司复训，因为目前仍在航校训练。我的现行训练计划包括航校的模拟机训练。

cards.audioText: When did you begin your initial flight training?
cards.audioTextZh: 你什么时候开始初始飞行训练？
cards.referenceText: I began my initial flight training in March last year.
cards.referenceTextZh: 我从去年三月开始初始飞行训练。

cards.audioText: What are the advantages of AR and VR applications used in your simulator training?
cards.audioTextZh: 在模拟机训练中使用AR和VR应用的优势是什么？
cards.referenceText: AR and VR technologies can make our simulator training more realistic, improve the quality of our training and flight skills, and better ensure flight safety.
cards.referenceTextZh: AR和VR技术可以让我们的模拟机训练更加真实，提升我们的训练质量和飞行技术，更好确保飞行安全。

cards.audioText: What do you know about AR and VR?
cards.audioTextZh: 关于AR和VR，你知道什么？
cards.referenceText: AR refers to augmented reality and VR refers to virtual reality. Both of them are new technologies and have been used in our simulator training.
cards.referenceTextZh: AR指的是增强现实，VR指的是虚拟现实。两者都是很先进的技术，也已经用于我们的模拟机训练。
